title: Three bright transients on 19 July 1952 found by Enrique Solano

tellings.quote: And then my colleague Enrique Solano in Spain, he discovered another such really beautiful example with three super bright beautiful stars. It's the most beautiful example of all we have. This one is from the 19th of July, 1952.

plain: An astronomer named Beatriz Villarroel studies old glass photographic plates from the Palomar Observatory in California, which recorded the night sky in the 1950s, and she looks for points of light that show up once and then vanish. On a podcast with host Jesse Michels, she says her colleague in Spain, Enrique Solano, found what she calls the most beautiful example of all: three very bright star-like points on a plate from 19 July 1952. If such flashes were real objects, they would point to something unexplained in the sky near Earth before any satellites had been launched.
